metadata.title: The Shenandoah Valley in 1864
metadata.creator: Pond, George E. (George Edward), 1837-1899
subject: Shenandoah Valley Campaign, 1864 (May-August)
Shenandoah Valley Campaign, 1864 (August-November)
description: The Valley of Virginia -- Cloyd's Mountain and New Market -- General Hunter's Lynchburg campaign -- Early Menaces Washington -- In the valley again -- Kernstown, Chambersburg, and Moorefield -- General Sheridan's march to Strasburg -- The Shenandoah lines in September -- The Battle of the Qpequon -- The Battle of Fisher's Hill -- Pursuing early and laying waste the Valley -- The Battle of Tom's Brook -- The Battle of Cedar Creek -- Waynesboro -- Appendix A: Opposing forces in the Shenandoah Valley -- Appendix B: Tables indicating numerical strength -- Appendix C: List of casualties and captures -- Appendix D: Confederate accounts of events
Lincoln copy: Handwritten signature in ink: Jno. G. Nicolay
